core.title: Extension Door Closer Arm for Hager 5200 Series

text.description_html:
Hager Extension Arm for Series 5200 Door Closer.

Fits Hagar 5200 Series Door Closers

Arm is non-handed. For use in top jamb applications when reveal is greater than 4" but less than 8".

Features for Hager 5908 extension arm

  • To Be Used with Hager 5200 Series Commercial Door Closers
  • Non Handed Arm
  • Cast Steel
  • 3 Hole Adjustable Shoe Included
  • Overall Length: 13.53 inches
